newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritian rupee weakens on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritian rupee weakens on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee fell against both the dollar and the British pound on Wednesday, which forex dealers said reflected international trends.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial bank mean rate of 20.1285 to the dollar from 20.0965 on Tuesday.
Against the British pound the rupee was posted at a mean rate of 33.2545 from 32.9860 on Tuesday.
The central bank intervened in the interbank forex market mid afternoon on Tuesday at a rate six cents higher than the prevailing interbank rate.
"Commercial banks are long in dollars for the moment after supply from market intervention on Tuesday," a dealer said.
